node.statement: Unconditional constant ledger, with no sign assumption on c_0^cb. In the fixed statement of this lemma, c_0^cb is a named ambient constant, not a variable quantified among A,epsilon,m,w,j; this is the ordinary binding structure of the root and of lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope. Put kappa:=abs(c_0^cb), a fixed finite nonnegative universal number. Choose the existential witnesses L,C_co,C_proj,C_np,C_pair,D_1 from the six named externals and enlarge their coefficient witnesses to at least 1. Define K_1:=max{1,kappa,L,C_proj*L,C_np*L,C_pair*L,C_co*(kappa+1)} and e_call_1:=min{e_env,e_co/(kappa+1),e_proj/L,e_np/L,e_pair/L,e_1/K_1}. All entries in the minimum are positive, so e_call_1>0; K_1 is finite, universal, and at least 1; K_1*e_call_1<=e_1. For 0<=epsilon<=e_call_1, epsilon<=e_env, L*epsilon<=e_proj,e_np,e_pair, (kappa+1)*epsilon<=e_co, and t_1:=K_1*epsilon<=e_1. Also c_0^cb*epsilon<=kappa*epsilon<=t_1 whenever that expression is the nonnegative defect parameter in the supplied inclusion, and (c_0^cb+1)*epsilon<= (kappa+1)*epsilon<=t_1. Thus the ledger uses no added hypothesis c_0^cb>=0 and no possibly nonpositive denominator.
